In addition to planning, developing and selling new-build condominiums under the “ＬＥＢＥＮ” and “ＮＥＢＥＬ” series nationwide, it carries out the full range of real estate business, including a securitization business that develops income-generating properties such as the “ＬＵＸＥＮＡ” series of residences and the “Ｌ．Ｂｉｚ” series of office buildings and sells them to the REIT market and others, new-build detached house sales, renovation resale business, real estate leasing and management business, and real estate brokerage business. Consolidated subsidiary Takara Leben Co., Ltd. is the core of the condominium business, Leben Community Co., Ltd. handles comprehensive management of condominiums, Leben Homebuild Co., Ltd. handles detached house sales, Takara Leben Real Net Co., Ltd. handles real estate distribution, Leben Zestock Co., Ltd. handles renovation resale, and Leben Trust Co., Ltd. handles rental management, each taking charge of its respective area. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥192,446 million, accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue.
